record.field: The audit was completed and reviewed with the client before any Meta-side or Odoo-side change was made.
WhatsApp messages can be sent and received through Odoo, and the client's mobile WhatsApp Business app still works normally on the same number.
The Facebook Page and Instagram Business account are correctly linked to each other and to the Business Portfolio, with no permission or verification errors outstanding.
Odoo's email integration sends and receives correctly for the client's domain.
Every permission in use is scoped to what the integration actually needs, using a long-lived, documented token.
The client holds admin ownership of every Meta asset and Odoo credential involved, and has a written reference for ongoing maintenance.
Every claim in the plan about coexistence, permissions, or verification was checked against Meta's and Odoo's current documentation for this specific account, not assumed from general knowledge.
